why:
rclrs 0.5 splits every entity into `X` (an `Arc<XState>` alias) and `XState` (the inherent impl); ours is one type. The correlator folds the suffix, so the members listed here are the ones with no counterpart at all -- see `rust:PublisherState::get_subscription_count` and the loan rows.

phase-428 W6 (2026-09-06) — disposition, required because this row's SHAPE CORRESPONDS: the name exists on the ported surface and the correlator files it `same`, so nothing in a build says the contract differs. That is the class RFC-0089 exists for.

WHAT THIS KEY IS, stated first because it decides the disposition: `rclrs::Publisher` is an ALIAS for `Arc<PublisherState>` with ZERO members of its own in the recorded surface, and the correlator folds the `State` suffix. So this row is a TYPE-NAME correspondence and no signature was compared — it lands in `same` through the non-callable branch, not by agreeing on anything.

UPSTREAM'S CONTRACT for the name: a publisher handle, shared, with `publish`, `topic_name`, `get_subscription_count`, `notify_on_subscriber_ready`, `borrow_loaned_message` and `can_loan_messages` on the state behind it.

OURS (corrected 2026-10-05, issue 1637): one type, no `Arc`. The earlier text said "no loan API — loans need a middleware that owns the buffer, which the RMW seam (RFC-0035) does not expose"; false — `EmbeddedRawPublisher` has `try_loan` / `loan` (`packages/core/nros-node/src/executor/handles.rs`), and `nros-rmw` has `SlotLending` behind its `lending` feature for zero-copy on backends that lend.

HOW A USER FINDS OUT: COMPILE ERROR on every absent member, each carried by its own row (`rust:PublisherState::get_subscription_count`, the loan rows). ADOPT-BOUNDED for the NAME and the concept; this row makes no claim about any member, by construction.

issue 1637 (2026-10-05) — ROW CORRECTED to the code (the loan sentence above), and MEASURED what this key is: the extractor resolves `nros::Publisher` to the RMW seam TRAIT `nros_rmw::Publisher` (`packages/core/nros-rmw/src/traits.rs`, re-exported by `packages/api/nros/src/lib.rs`), not to a typed handle. The trait's rustdoc now says so where a reader meets the name: rclrs's `Publisher<T>` is a typed shared handle, this is the backend seam, the typed handle a node returns is `EmbeddedPublisher<M>` (one type, no `Arc`), and loaning is `try_loan`/`loan` with `SlotLending` under `lending`. That statement is the envelope.
